upheld.title: Redundant and tautological assertions in the spec
upheld.detail: openCart asserts the URL twice (toHaveURL(/\/cart$/) then pathname toBe('/cart')). The title steps assert toHaveTitle(EXPECTED_TITLE) and then page.title() toBe(EXPECTED_TITLE), and TC-PRB-1-01 adds expect(title).not.toBe(OLD_TITLE), which can never fail once the equality check above it has passed.
upheld.requirement: pr-check-style guideline 2: no duplicated logic or unexplained complexity; neighboring specs (e.g. e2e/teststack/bug-32.spec.ts) make one web-first assertion per expectation

upheld.title: Inline structural type duplicates the exported Demo interface
upheld.detail: signIn types its demo parameter as an inline { highlight: (l: Locator, label?: string) => Promise<void> } even though e2e/demo.ts exports the Demo interface for this fixture. The copy can drift from the real fixture type.
upheld.requirement: Reuse existing types instead of duplicating them; e2e/demo.ts:11 exports `interface Demo`
